headline: Canva Restructures Workforce Amid Slower Growth
summary: Design software company Canva announced a restructure affecting roughly a fifth of its workforce, citing its first period of slowed growth in a decade.
why: Canva is a major global software provider specializing in online graphic design tools and collaborative workplace applications.

impacts.name: Canva
impacts.why: Downsizing and slower revenue growth reflect normalization in tech sector demand after years of rapid expansion.
